acceptance.given: A capability specification uses secrets and is evaluated by the skill-quality validator.

oracle.expected: Validator output identifies the capability's named redaction policy and does not expose secret values or allow raw secret output locations.
forbidden: A secret-using capability omits its redaction policy.
Validator output includes a raw secret value or accepts an undeclared raw-secret output location.
oracle.observable: Structured validator result contains an A15 rule/status record with the inspected location and rule identifier, without secret contents.

acceptance.then: The capability names its redaction policy, and validation reports that policy boundary without revealing credential material.
acceptance.when: Run the frozen A15 validator case against a disposable package containing a secret-using capability and synthetic secret markers.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a15 must observe an AssertionError or equivalent failing assertion when a secret-using capability lacks a redaction policy, with the A15 rule and location identified.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce A15 validation requiring a named redaction policy for secret-using capabilities and diagnostics that expose only rule/location metadata.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the A15 validator rule and diagnostics while preserving the existing validator result schema and package compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Secret-using capability specifications become valid only when a redaction policy is explicitly named and raw secret output is denied.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A15 pytest case and applicable capability-module regression selection pass with structured rule/location assertions and no secret material in output.
